data.name: Pagal
data.long_meaning: The name Pagal is derived from the Hindi and Sanskrit words ‘pagal’ or ‘pakal’ which mean ‘foolish’, ‘crazy’, or ‘insane’. This name was often used to describe characters in ancient Hindu literature who were known for their unconventional behavior or lack of reason. In some cases, the term was also used to describe sages or spiritual masters who possessed a deep understanding of the universe but appeared to be irrational or unconventional to outsiders.
